# Jobsquirrel

> An open, self-hosted job-application agent. It finds roles, tailors a CV
> (resume) and cover letter per role, gates them for accuracy and quality, applies
> through the employer's own ATS with a real browser, and tracks replies. The
> dashboard, register, knowledge graph and documents run on your machine; the
> model provider can be local.

- Source: https://github.com/bongomanuk/jobsquirrel
- Docs: https://bongomanuk.github.io/jobsquirrel/
- Licence: Apache-2.0
- Topics: job search, job application, resume, CV, cover letter, AI agent, LLM,
  GraphRAG, self-hosted, local-first, privacy, Python, ATS, automation.

## Start here

- [Introduction](https://bongomanuk.github.io/jobsquirrel/INTRO/): what it is and how it works end to end.
- [Setup](https://bongomanuk.github.io/jobsquirrel/SETUP/): install, dependencies, configuration, Gmail.
- [Agent setup](https://bongomanuk.github.io/jobsquirrel/AGENT-SETUP/): opencode, Claude Code, Cursor, and running fully local.
- [Using it](https://bongomanuk.github.io/jobsquirrel/USING-IT/): prompts, monitoring, the state model and the grid.
- [The adaptive harness](https://bongomanuk.github.io/jobsquirrel/ADAPTIVE-HARNESS/): a separate agent for unknown forms, and the boundary it must not cross.

## Safety

- [The scam detector](https://bongomanuk.github.io/jobsquirrel/SCAMS/): the hard rule, every signal, email checks and the limits.
- [Eligibility and accuracy rules](https://bongomanuk.github.io/jobsquirrel/ELIGIBILITY/): the rules that keep applications honest.
